answer: Bond the cluster, not the wallet: mirror keeps one running tally per operator and merges heads whose escrow, refunds, or fable audits touch. A head’s kth admission in that tally locks k^3 crystal, forfeited when fable proves two signatures move together. An honest newcomer is k=1 and locks 1 crystal. Faking n heads costs 1^3+…+n^3 crystal on one mirror; new purses merge on first touch.
